title: Salaried GP
descriptionHtml:
Looking for a GP role where your wellbeing, development and work-life balance genuinely matter?

Beechfield Medical Centre is an award-winning, forward-thinking GP practice in Spalding, Lincolnshire, recruiting a Salaried GP for up to 8 sessions per week, with flexible working considered and a starting salary of £92,000 FTE.

We offer a structured and supportive working day, with 15-minute appointments, up to 14 patients per clinical session, dedicated administration time, protected breaks, daily clinical huddles and an established GP Buddy System. Home visits and triage responsibilities are shared across our multidisciplinary clinical team.

As an accredited GP Training Practice and RCGP Research Ready practice, we offer protected learning time, annual study leave, opportunities to develop specialist interests and a genuine commitment to professional development.

Our benefits include MDU membership reimbursement, enhanced mileage, discounted gym memberships, Cycle to Work Scheme and dedicated wellbeing support.

With 5 Star Quality Award recognition, People Promise Trailblazer Gold and Gold Learning Disability Friendly accreditation, we're proud of our supportive culture and commitment to continuous improvement.

Join a practice where teamwork is valued, innovation is encouraged and sustainable general practice is a shared priority.

  • Our typical GP working day includes:

    • Up to 14 patient appointments per clinical session, with the majority of consultations being face-to-face.
    • 15-minute appointments as our standard consultation length.
    • Dedicated clinical administration time built into each session.
    • Protected time for a lunch break and afternoon break.
    • Daily clinical huddles during the morning break, providing an opportunity for discussion, shared learning and team support.
    • Additional scheduled administration sessions before and after periods of annual leave to support workload management and continuity.
    • Home visiting responsibilities shared across the GP and practitioner teams, with a maximum of two visits per GP per day.
    • Structured clinical pathways and effective signposting to ensure patients are seen by the most appropriate healthcare professional.

    We understand that sustainable general practice requires more than simply managing appointment numbers. It requires effective teamwork, protected time, clear processes and a shared commitment to working smarter.

At Beechfield Medical Centre, we believe that looking after our people is fundamental to looking after our patients.

We are an ambitious, forward-thinking and award-winning GP practice in Spalding, Lincolnshire, and we are looking for an enthusiastic Salaried GP to join our established clinical team.

We are recruiting for up to 8 sessions per week, with flexibility to accommodate different working patterns and individual circumstances.

Whether you are an experienced GP seeking a fresh opportunity, a newly qualified GP beginning your career, or someone looking for a practice that values collaboration, innovation and professional development, we would love to hear from you.

We are proud of the culture we have created at Beechfield and the systems we have developed to support our clinicians. Our aim is simple: to provide excellent patient care while creating a sustainable, enjoyable and professionally rewarding environment in which our team can thrive.

title: Specialist Doctor in General Surgery
descriptionHtml:
This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced General Surgeon to join the cohesive and forward-thinking General Surgery team at Northampton General Hospital (NGH) in a substantive Specialist appointment. The successful candidate will contribute to the delivery and development of high-quality inpatient and outpatient surgical services, supporting routine, cancer and elective activity. This role offers the opportunity to develop a specialist interest within General Surgery, contribute to service improvement and take an active role in the leadership and development of the department. We are seeking an experienced General Surgeon with a minimum of five years' experience at Registrar level within the UK NHS, who is committed to delivering excellent, patient-centred care and working collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team.

Key Duties include:

  • Deliver high-quality inpatient and outpatient General Surgical services, contributing to elective, cancer and waiting-list activity targets.

  • Support the continued development of elective surgical services and, where required, contribute to the management of surgical emergencies.

  • Develop areas of sub-specialisation and specialist interest in line with departmental needs.

  • Contribute to clinical leadership, service development, clinical audit, patient safety and quality improvement initiatives.

  • Support the teaching, supervision and professional development of junior and middle-grade medical staff.

  • Work collaboratively with the multidisciplinary team to improve patient pathways, service efficiency and the quality of care.

Please submit your application as soon as possible as we reserve the right to close adverts once we have received sufficient applications

Northampton General Hospital NHS Trust is on an exciting journey with all of our divisions committed to doing things better, with more efficiency as we update, modernise, and advance. We have also entered a Group Model with neighbouring Kettering General Hospital NHS Foundation Trust and become University Hospitals of Northamptonshire (UHN). As part of this collaborative approach, there may be a requirement for you to work across both the Kettering and Northampton hospital sites, depending on the needs of the service.

Our Excellence Values

  • Compassion
  • Accountability
  • Respect
  • Integrity
  • Courage

We want to recruit the best people to deliver our services across UHN and help to unleash everyone's full potential.

UHN encourages applications from people who identify from all protected groups. We understand that we need to work with colleagues from diverse backgrounds and make sure the environment they work in is inclusive and collaborative.

We recognise the valuable contribution that the Armed Forces community make to our organisation. We have signed the Armed Forces Covenant and achieved Silver Award under the Armed Forces Employer Recognition Scheme.

We have active Networks that promote and support colleagues from all backgrounds. This ensures everyone feels supported and has a sense of belonging working for UHN.

employer: Cardiff and Vale University Health Board
title: Junior Clinical Fellow in Neurosurgery
descriptionHtml:
Applications are invited for a Clinical Fellow in Neurosurgery within Cardiff and Vale Health Board which is fixed term for 12 months from 30th November 2026.

The ward based aspect of the post involves being an active member of a team consisting of resident doctors, clinical nurse specialists and nurse practitioners under the guidance of a neurosurgical consultant.

As well as operative experience and exposure to neurosurgical high care, the post offers the unique opportunity to gain experience across a number of neurosurgical sub speciality. The clinical fellow will work closely with all services within the Neurosurgery department to ensure continuity of care and development of treatment pathways. Other sub-speciality interests may be developed within the unit subject to mutual agreement. There will be an expectation to assist in the development of pre-admission assessment services.

This post has proven highly successful for previous post holders as a step towards their future applications for specialist training. The resident clinical fellows are encouraged to get involved in research as well as audit projects to present at monthly neurosurgical Quality and Safety meetings based at the University Hospital of Wales.

Cardiff & Vale is a teaching health board with close links to Cardiff University. The University boasts a high-profile teaching, research and development role within the UK and abroad. Together we are training the next generation of medical professionals.

The Clinical Fellow will undertake a broad range of clinical duties across the Neurosurgery service, including the neurosurgical wards and Neuroscience High Dependency Unit whilst participating in the departmental on call rota. This role provides excellent exposure to the assessment and management of complex neurosurgical patients, offering valuable experience in both acute and elective neurosurgical care within a tertiary neuroscience centre.

Cardiff and Vale University Health Board is one of the largest Integrated Health Boards in the UK, employing over 15,000 staff, providing over 100 specialist services. Working across 6 hospital sites, we have a diverse range of career opportunities to offer. Serving around 500,000 people living in Cardiff and the Vale of Glamorgan, we are focussed on the health and care needs of our local population whilst working with our partners to develop regional services.

Our mission is"Caring for People, Keeping People Well",and ourvision is that every person's chance of leading a healthy life should be equal. As an organisation we are unashamedly ambitious for our population's health, rising to the challenges of today and tomorrow through our 10-year strategy, Shaping our Future Wellbeing. Cardiff, the thriving Welsh capital, is a fantastic city to live and work in with an abundance of sports, arts and cultural attractions. title: Locum Anaesthetics Consultant
descriptionHtml:
We are looking to recruit an NHS Locum Consultant Anaesthetist who is skilled at providing:

  • General anaesthesia for major general, urology and gynae-oncology surgery.
  • General anaesthesia with an interest in obstetric anaesthesia.

This vacancy has risen due to a combination retirements and service expansion. The successful applicant will join an existing team of 43 consultants, 6 SAS doctors and 37 junior doctors.

title: Maternity Locum cover - Salaried GP
descriptionHtml:
The Reddish Family Practice is a friendly and progressive two-site GP practice within Stockport, just inside the M60 with easy access to Manchester and the Peak District. We are looking for 6 sessions maternity leave cover for one of our colleagues.

Serving around 11,500 patients, we have a well-established clinical team comprising 5 GP Partners, 1 Clinical Pharmacist Partner and 5 Salaried GPs, alongside an extensive wider multidisciplinary team, working closely with Tame Valley PCN.

We pride ourselves on providing excellent patient care while supporting the wellbeing, development and contribution of our staff. We are a training practice and have a positive approach to innovation; continually looking for ways to improve the services we provide and way we work.

We have a "Good" CQC rating (2016) and strong QOF and Enhanced Service achievement, long term condition review system, and offer an extensive range of services onsite including minor surgery, phlebotomy and ECGs; reflecting our commitment to high standards of clinical care and practice organisation. Further role benefits include:

  • Contract based on BMA Standard GP Contract terms and Conditions
  • 6 weeks annual leave, 1 week study leave pro rata. NHS Pension, Indemnity reimbursed by practice.
  • Probationary period of 3 months, and annual review and development review supported.
  • Opportunities to pursue special interests as available.

We reserve the right to close applications early should we receive a high volume of interest

The Reddish Family Practice is looking to recruit an enthusiastic and committed Maternity LocumGP for 6 sessions per week (Tue, Thu, Friday) to join our friendly, busy and supportive practice team. Duties and features include:

  • Up to 25 patient appointments in clinic per day mix of phone and f2f, plus 1-2 home visits. Extras are dealt with by the on-call GP.
  • 10 or 15 minute appointments with catchups as preferred by the clinician
  • Clinical and results admin are shared between the GPs in practice per day.
  • Weekly clinical team meetings to discuss cases.
  • Supervision slots provided to support with supervision of trainees
  • Emis Web clinical system, with integrated AccuRx for online triage. Docman and Microsoft 365. Teamnet for HR
  • Clinical admin and results are shared between the GPs in practice per day.
  • Rota'd oncall / Triage half days - 1-2 sessions per week working with 2nd on call GP and Reception triage support team.
  • Team works across both sites to provide consistent care and rota'd sessions.
  • Opportunities for extended access cover Tuesday nights 6.30 - 8pm and Autumn Saturday Flu clinics. Saturdays (1in 6) rota'd usually by partnership.
  • Further clinical support provided by Nursing and HCA team, Admin and Secretarial, SIPS Pharmacy team, FCP Physio team, Cancer Care Coordinator, Health & Wellbeing Coordinator, Social Prescribers, Mental Health Coordinators amongst others.

A full Job description will be provided on request and application.

The Reddish Family Practice is proud to be a friendly, supportive and collaborative practice. We encourage open communication across our clinical and non-clinical teams, with regular opportunities for cross-team learning through projects, training days and meetings, alongside social events throughout the year.

We strive to be Safe, Caring, Responsive, Effective and Well Led in everything we do. We recognise and celebrate good performance, providing training and development where needed. We promote an open, blame-free culture where staff feel able to speak up, learn from events to contribute to improving the quality and safety of care.

We serve a diverse population and to better understand and respond to the needs of our communityare a Veteran Friendly, and a Gambling Aware Practice. We are working towards the Silver Award for Pride in Practice.We take part in Oliver McGowan training, have had training with the African-Caribbean Health Network, and have an active patient group.

We were early adopters of total triage and online requests, and have seen improved patient outcomes through focused collaboration with North West Hearts and other healthcare providers.

Our shared daily GP administration and regular clinical meetings promote teamwork and avoids individual GPs managing administrative workloads in isolation.

Above all, we aim to create a workplace where staff feel valued, supported, listened to and able to thrive, while delivering excellent care to our patients.

title: Weekday Professional Line (WDPL) GP
descriptionHtml:
This is a senior, weekday GP role at theprimary-secondary care interface. You'll speak with GPs and other community clinicians about acute medical presentations, agree a clear plan, and support the best next step for each patient. You'll help teamsavoid admissions where safe, and when hospital care is needed,support timely referral via the right route.

Based at Osprey Court, you'll work within a supportive multidisciplinary team alongside System CAS colleagues. The role is varied and offers a strong mix of clinical thinking, professional collaboration and system knowledge across BNSSG.

The WDPL team operates 08:00-18:30, Monday to Friday, and is based at Osprey Court. We receive calls from primary care clinicians and other community healthcare professionals seeking advice or admission for adult patients with acute medical presentations.

Our key function is to:

  • explore management pathways not yet considered that could support safe community management, and
  • facilitate admission to hospital via the most appropriate route when required.

We provide this service for patients within the catchment of the three BNSSG acute hospitals: Southmead Hospital, Bristol Royal Infirmary and Weston General Hospital.

You'll also receive a small number of cases from NHS 111 during the day (including poisonings), and you'll work alongside the System Clinical Assessment Service (System CAS) team, supporting remote clinical assessment for patients who might otherwise be directed to ED or 999 without clinical input.

BrisDoc is an employee-owned social enterprise that has been providing NHS healthcare for over twenty years. Serving more than one million patients across Bristol, North Somerset, and South Gloucestershire, BrisDoc offers a range of primary care services, including:

  • Severnside Integrated Urgent Care (IUC):A 24/7 NHS urgent care service combining NHS 111 and the GP Out of Hours Service, and more, ensuring patients receive timely medical attention when their GP practice is closed
  • In-Hours Primary Care:Operating GP practices such as Broadmead Medical Centre and Charlotte Keel Medical Practice, providing comprehensive healthcare services during standard hours
  • Homeless Health Service:Dedicated to addressing the healthcare needs of homeless individuals, offering support through clinics and outreach teams

As a social enterprise, BrisDoc prioritises the health of its patients, environmental sustainability, and the social and economic well-being of the community. The organisation is committed to reducing health inequalities and improving overall well-being.

At BrisDoc, we are proud to be anemployee-ownedorganisation, meaning every member of our team is a 'co-owner' with a real stake in the success of the business. This unique structure empowers our staff to influence decisions, shape the future direction of the organisation, and take pride in the care and services we provide.

title: Advanced Nurse Practitioner (ANP)

Swadlincote Surgery is a long established training practice with a list size of 14,000 patients. The ANP role benefits from the support of an experienced clinical and admin practice team.

We are looking for a dynamic and motivated ANP to join us to support us in continuing to provide an excellent healthcare experience for all of our patients.

If you have a specialist area of interest please also include this within your application.

The successful Advanced Nurse Practitioner will work as an autonomous practitioner, diagnosing, managing, prescribing and discharging patients with illness or injury across all age groups including young children. This will be by face-to-face consultations.

What we are looking for in an Advanced Nurse Practitioner:

  • Hold an Advanced Nurse Practitioner qualification
  • Can show evidence of using autonomous physical examination and assessment skills in practice
  • Can demonstrate a broad and sound knowledge of complex and common conditions in primary care in both adults and children
About us

The team you will be working with as an Advanced Nurse Practitioner;

  • A fully staffed multi-disciplinary team including a full complement of Administration Staff
  • The team are a progressive and collaborative group, ready to welcome on board any successful additions
  • Teamwork and mutual support are integral to our working practices and the successful Advanced Nurse Practitioner must share this vision.

Swadlincote Surgery is committed to providing a supportive environment for all of our staff, where staff are actively encouraged to develop and grow. The team benefit from an array of experienced clinicians, managers and GP partners who are open, supportive and make for a fantastic team environment.

We are active with the local PCN and are forward thinking in terms of developing new initiatives to offer enhanced services to our patients.

The practice is a teaching practice.

If you have a specialist interest we are keen to encourage development within this area in line with the demands associated with our practice demographic.

title: Renal Trust Grade Registrar SPR
descriptionHtml:
This is a fantastic opportunity to work at Croydon University Hospital as a Renal and General Medicine Registrar. This 12-month fixed-term position at Croydon University Hospital is designed for an ambitious doctor committed to transitioning into ST4 specialty training in Renal Medicine or systematically compiling competencies for a JRCPTB e-portfolio. Working alongside substantive specialty trainees, you will receive full consultant supervision and identical training opportunities across both nephrology and general internal medicine. Our department is dedicated to delivering outstanding local and specialist care while providing a vibrant environment for junior doctors to innovate, complete audits, and build a competitive portfolio for higher specialty applications.
  • Medical Registrar On-Call Rota: Participate actively in the Medical Registrar on-call rota, taking leadership responsibility for the assessment, management, and triage of unselected acute medical admissions.
  • Renal Inpatient & Referrals: Manage and evaluate inpatient and acute renal referrals on a context-dependent basis, providing specialized nephrology advice, triage, and structured management plans under consultant guidance.
  • Patient Management: Deliver comprehensive, high-quality day-to-day care for a blended cohort of general medical inpatients and dedicated renal firm patients, addressing complex multi-system illness, acute kidney injury (AKI), and chronic kidney disease (CKD).
  • Outpatient Clinics: Attend and actively participate in consultant-supervised outpatient renal clinics, renal hot clinic and hypertension clinic for young people.
  • Leadership: Lead and coordinate ward-based multidisciplinary team (MDT) meetings, ensuring safe patient reviews, efficient treatment execution, and seamless discharge or specialty transitions.
  • FY1 Supervision: Provide focused clinical supervision, bedside teaching, and daily support exclusively to Foundation Year 1 (FY1) doctors on the unit.
  • E-Portfolio & Governance: Utilize protected educational opportunities to gather workplace-based assessments (WPBAs), reflections, and case-based discussions for your ST4 portfolio, supported by departmental audits and quality improvement projects (QIPs)

Croydon Health Services NHS Trust provide hospital and community services from a number of community and specialist clinics throughout Croydon. The Trust was formed on 1st August 2010 through the integration of Croydon Community Health Services and Mayday Healthcare NHS Trust. Around 4,100 staff provide services for a population of over 360,000 people who are relatively young with a high level of ethnic diversity.

Our main hospital site, Croydon University Hospital is one of the busiest in London. We're also leading the way in providing more healthcare outside hospitals at clinics, specialist centres and in people's homes. Our experienced district nursing teams, Allied Health Professionals and community matrons look after people of all ages across Croydon and our Children's Hospital at Home cares for children with long-term conditions without them having to come to hospital.

Across the NHS everyone is working hard to meet growing demand and we're no exception. But with the right people on board, we are rising to this challenge, putting our people in the driving seat, encouraging innovation and transforming our services to give local people the quality of care they deserve. Croydon Health Services puts a great deal of importance on education and training throughout the careers of all of our staff. As well as offering access to a range of core skills training and professional development.

employer: Lancashire Teaching Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust
title: Consultant in Cellular Pathology
descriptionHtml:
We have a vacancy arise for a Consultant post in Cellular Pathology. This will be based be based at Royal Preston Hospital.

The working week will be - Monday-Friday 9am to 5pm with no expectation of providing on call for this post.

The successful applicant will join our team of consultants and will be required to provide a comprehensive histopathology service.

You will also be required to develop specialist interests to complement the existing specialist Cancer services.

You will be expected to co-operate with other members of the Pathology Directorate to ensure effective administrative arrangements are made in the laboratory, which will include: -

employer: Wirral University Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust

title: Consultant Haematologist
descriptionHtml:
The haematology service sits within the Haematology & Immunology service line with consultant haematology posts part funded by the Pathology directorate. The consultant haematology team is currently comprised of 11 consultant haematologists (9.43WTE including 0.2WTE research university funded post). This is a new post for a consultant to expand our team with increased myeloma activity and CAR-T development planned in this financial year.

The consultant team is supported by 5.8WTE Registrar posts, 1WTE research registrar and 1 registrar teaching fellow. There are in addition 4 junior doctors rotating on a 4-monthly basis through the inpatient ward, these are made of 1 F2 post, 3 IMT1/2 posts and a physician associate.

Consultants contribute towards the management of inpatients and outpatients. Patients are formally under the shared care of all consultants as a combined department with responsibility for inpatients managed on a rolling weekly 'attending' rota. All consultants contribute towards the Monday morning ward round hand over meeting. The weekly attending consultant leads a further ward round on a Thursday. The attending consultant of the week is responsible for all inpatients under the care of haematology, including SCT patients. Myeloma clinic

Myeloma trials clinic

CLL clinic

Participation in CAR-T cell patient assessments and treatment planning.

Weekly Monday ward round

Weekly Friday departmental integrated diagnostics meeting

You will be expected to be on call for a week at a time on a 1 in 8.5 basis, although this may be adjusted to suit those looking to work on a less than full time basis. During an on call week, you will be responsible for all inpatients, new patients and day unit patients. On call duties are supported by a haematology specialist registrar on call.

The post will be reimbursed at the rate of 10 PAs for full time appointments. 1.5 are dedicated as SPAs.

The post holder will have a commitment to regular teaching at undergraduate, postgraduate and specialist registrar level.

employer: Kingston and Richmond NHS Foundation Trust
title: Senior Clinical Fellow in Thyroid, Parathyroid and Head & Neck Surgery
descriptionHtml:
**Please Note: Due to the high volume of applications, we may close this vacancy early***

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a 12-month Senior Clinical Fellowship in Thyroid, Parathyroid and Robotic Head & Neck Surgery at Kingston and Richmond NHS Foundation Trust.

This unique fellowship offers advanced training in the full spectrum of benign and malignant Head & Neck Surgery, with particular emphasis on thyroid and parathyroid disease, surgeon-performed ultrasound, minimally invasive interventions and robotic surgery.

The department provides comprehensive multidisciplinary care through dedicated one-stop diagnostic clinics delivered in collaboration with Endocrinology, Radiology and Cellular Pathology. The service manages a high volume of endocrine neck pathology and performs over 120 thyroid and parathyroid procedures annually, including complex thyroid surgery, minimally invasive parathyroidectomy and re-operative endocrine surgery.

The successful candidate will gain extensive experience in surgeon-performed head and neck ultrasound, ultrasound-guided diagnostic procedures, endocrine neck surgery, robotic surgery and multidisciplinary management of head and neck disease. The fellowship provides an exceptional opportunity for senior trainees approaching CCT, post-CCT fellows or newly appointed consultants wishing to develop advanced subspecialist expertise in endocrine head and neck surgery.

The post holder will:

o Participate in the assessment, investigation and management of patients with benign and malignant head and neck conditions.

o Undertake supervised and independent operating across the spectrum of thyroid, parathyroid and head and neck surgery according to experience and competency.

o Attend dedicated thyroid, parathyroid and head and neck clinics, including one-stop diagnostic clinics.

o Develop competency in head and neck ultrasound, including thyroid, salivary gland and cervical lymph node assessment, with opportunities for ultrasound-guided fine needle aspiration and core biopsy.

o Gain exposure to thyroid thermal ablation techniques, including radiofrequency ablation (RFA) and microwave ablation (MWA).

o Participate in robotic head and neck and endocrine surgery, including exposure to Transoral Robotic Thyroidectomy Vestibular Approach (TORTVA) and Transoral Robotic Parathyroidectomy Vestibular Approach (TORPVA).

o Participate in weekly Head & Neck Cancer and Endocrine MDT meetings and contribute to multidisciplinary decision-making.

o Contribute to the delivery and development of the Head & Neck, Thyroid and Parathyroid services in accordance with Trust objectives.

o Provide clinical supervision and teaching for junior medical staff, medical students and allied healthcare professionals.

o Participate in clinical audit, quality improvement, research and service development projects.

Development and staff wellbeing

Your growth and happiness matters to us. After all, we can't expect the best from you if we don't invest in your development and nurture your wellbeing. From the moment you join us, we're committed to fostering your professional and personal development within a supportive, empowering environment. Whether you're just starting your career or looking to advance further, we provide you with the tools and opportunities you need to succeed. We actively support colleagues to take part in research, quality improvement and innovation, whatever their role or level in the organisation.

To support your wellbeing, we offer an extensive range of resources, including an on-site staff nursery at Kingston Hospital, wellbeing practitioners, wellbeing classes, dedicated staff physiotherapist, comprehensive occupational health services, 24/7 employee assistance programme, and a range of other support and activities.

We also take every opportunity to thank and recognise the work our teams do, through weekly 'shoutouts' and patient feedback, monthly and annual awards.

Wherever you work across our organisation, we look forward to welcoming you.

title: Consultant in Liaison Psychiatry - Exeter
descriptionHtml:

Why Choose Us?

Join a multidisciplinary team of dedicated professionals, including Nurses, Occupational Therapists, Social Workers, Liaison Psychologists, Consultant Psychiatrists, and Trainee Doctors. Together, we foster a collaborative and supportive environment.

descriptionHtml:
GUY'S AND ST THOMAS' NHS FOUNDATION TRUST

Out of Programme Training Experience (OOPTE) in Clinical Toxicology (ST4-7) and Senior Fellow in Emergency Medicine [12 month post]

Both Guys and St Thomas' have central London locations with stunning views across the Thames and are close to many tourist attractions, such as the Houses of Parliament and the South Bank Arts Complex. Both sites have easy access to major transport links

The post will be split 50:50 between Emergency Medicine and Clinical Toxicology. The post holder will participate in the ED night (60%) and weekend rota (75%) of the fulltime post.

Emergency Medicine: You will participate in a middle grade rota working with other senior ED trainees and supervising junior middle grades, FY2s and ENPs. The Department sees over 150,000 new patients per annum and has a separate Paediatric Emergency Department associated with the Evelina London Children's Hospital.

These are fixed term appointments for UHDB NHS Foundation Trust based at Derbyshire Children's Hospital at the Royal Derby Hospital, although other services are provided across all the Trust sites including the Queens Hospital Burton site and peripheral clinics at Ilkeston, Lichfield and Tamworth. It is not anticipated that these post will require any cross-site working. We are looking for an enthusiastic Paediatric Emergency trained doctor to join our flexible team and complement the range of services provided. The appointee should have PEM grid training, or have paediatric subspecialty training via RCEM route, or be able to demonstrate equivalent training.

Any applicant who wishes to work less than full time will be eligible to be considered for the post; if such a person is appointed, modification of the job content will be discussed on a personal basis with the Paediatric Clinical Director and Assistant Clinical Director for the Children's Emergency Department in consultation with consultant colleagues

Maintenance of the highest clinical standards in the management of a Paediatric Urgent and Emergency Care service

Develop interest to complement current consultant team

To share with colleagues' responsibility for the day-to-day management of the Children's Emergency Department

Teaching & training of junior staff, medical students

To actively participate in both departmental & Trust matters concerning Clinical Governance & audit.

To have responsibility for ensuring active participation in continuing medical education (CME).

As a trusted organisation at the heart of our communities, we recognise the important role we can play in supporting the public, patients, our own people and local partners in achieving the best of health for the local population and the communities in which they live by providing Exceptional Care Together

Our fundamental Values of Compassion, Openness and Excellence underpin how we intend to work as a Trust and the associated behaviours are becoming embedded in all aspects of how we work.

In return we will offer:

  • Development opportunities, both professional and leadership development
  • On-going support from recruitment to when you join our team and beyond.
  • Staff benefits including employee assistance programme, discounted gym membership, onsite fitness classes, car schemes

Key Facts:

  • We see on average 4810 OP appointments a day.
  • We are the 4th busiest Trauma & Orthopaedic outpatients department in England - an average of 2077 per week.
  • An average of 1115 patients are seen in A&Es across our network every day - 3rd largest in the country.
  • Our hospitals admit an average of 195 emergency patients daily.
  • Last year we undertook almost 33,700 planned surgical operations in our 57 operating theatres.
  • We are one of only 7 Trusts nationally with more than 50 operating theatres.
  • We carry out more than 140 elective procedures each working day.
  • UHDB is a research active University Hospital with a large and varied portfolio of clinical trials and research opportunities for all staff

title: GP Partner
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a friendly and enthusiastic GP to join our team at Combe Coastal Practice in beautiful North Devon, situated in an Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty in one of the only UK World Surfing Reserves with 2 National Parks located on its doorstep.

To provide high-quality, safe and effective general medical services to the practice population, working as part of a multidisciplinary team. The post-holder will contribute to the delivery of primary medical services, clinical governance, and service development. There is a clear intention to support the successful candidate towards afuture partnership opportunity, subject to mutual agreement, business need and performance.

Combe Coastal Practice is one the largest Practices in North Devon with a list size of approx 18,000 patients. Nestled between the sandy surfing beaches of Woolacombe and Croyde, and the rugged cliffs of Exmoor, we are perfectly situated for those looking for an amazing outdoors lifestyle whilst also delivering high quality patient care. Our clinical team comprises of Partners and Salaried GPs, a large nursing & patient coordinator team, and an ever-expanding team of multidisciplinary professionals via the PCN ARRS scheme including Paramedics, Clinical Pharmacists, FCPs, O/T's and Health & Wellbeing Team. Patient care is delivered from our main surgery in the harbour town of Ilfracombe and 2 branch surgeries in the coastal villages of Woolacombe and Combe Martin. Visa sponsorship is available for potential applicants if required

title: Dispenser
descriptionHtml:
We have a position available for a qualified and experienced dispenser to join our busy Dispensary Team at Market Cross Surgery; an expanding rural practice situated in the village of Corby Glen.

The requirements for this vacancy are:

  • Formal dispensing qualification essential (Level 2 Equivalent)
  • Previous General Practice experience essential; duties to include:
    • Ensure all medicines and appliances are dispensed and checked against the prescription
    • Ensure Controlled Drugs (CDs) are ordered, overseen and recorded appropriately
    • Operation of efficient stock control
    • Complete end of month PPA submission
    • Monthly out of date duties as required
  • To undertake any necessary work as may be required and appropriate to maintain a high standard and efficient dispensing service
  • Computer literate - knowledge of SystmOne

Advantageous

  • Attention to detail and accuracy essential
  • Excellent telephone/customer service skills essential
  • Team player who can provide flexibility in hours and duties.
  • Annual Leave entitlement 5 weeks (pro-rata)
  • Salary depending on qualification and experience
  • Inclusion in Pension Scheme

Confidentiality

In the course of seeking treatment, patients entrust us with or allow us to gather, sensitive information in relation to their health and other matters. They do so in confidence and have the right to expect that staff will respect their privacy and act appropriately.

We are an expanding rural practice with four GP Partners, one salaried GP and a dedicated team of nurses, administrative staff and dispensary staff. We all work to the same ethos of putting our patients needs first and believe in a team working environment.

employer: East Kent Hospitals University NHS Foundation Trust
title: Consultant in Anaesthetics (QEH)
descriptionHtml:
The Anaesthetic Department at the Queen Elizabeth the Queen Mother Hospital is looking to recruit a dynamic and forward-thinking individual to join our team of dedicated clinicians. Queen Elizabeth the Queen Mother Hospital is a large district general hospital providing care for the diverse population across East Kent.

Job plans within the Anaesthetic Department at the Queen Elizabeth the Queen Mother Hospital are flexible and can be honed to reflect the particular skills and experience of the applicant. Many specialist clinical interests can be supported, either within Queen Elizabeth the Queen Mother Hospital or across the trust. With this 10 PA position, there is a 2 PA allocation for SPA, during which there is an expectation that the successful candidate will be fully involved with Audit and QI initiatives within the department and the Care Group, as well as educational and research roles and completion of mandatory training.

We are one of the largest hospital trusts in England, with five hospitals and community clinics serving a local population of around 800,000 people. Our vision is 'great healthcare from great people'. Everything we do is guided by our values: 'People feel cared for, safe, respected and confident that we are making a difference'. We have a new way of working at East Kent Hospitals, called 'We care'. It's about empowering frontline staff to lead improvements day-to-day. We're looking for compassionate people to be part of our improvement journey for the patients, families and carers we care for every day.

Please note that if you require a Certificate of Sponsorship to work in the UK you must declare this on your application form, even if you currently have a certificate of sponsorship or a work permit for another role and are already working in the country. Please note we are only able to sponsor candidates on a Skilled Worker Visa applying for roles Band 5 and above.

title: Salaried GP
descriptionHtml:
We are a GP Practice in Swindon, looking to recruit an enthusiastic and motivated Salaried GP. With a growing practice population, we are keen to continue to develop our clinical team.

We are looking for someone with excellent communication skills and a commitment to working as part of a strong and effective clinical team. We are flexible in terms of hours and a competitive salary will be offered to reflect the successful candidates experience and qualifications.

Whalebridge Practice is looking for a Salaried GP to join their multi-disciplinary team, to work over 3 sites within Swindon.

The role is part time and the rate of remuneration will be based on qualifications and experience. The successful candidate will ideally work 2 days a week.

title: Bank Phlebotomist
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for an experienced Phlebotomist to join our team, working 12 hours per week as required (salary pro-rata). The successful candidate will support the registered nursing team in delivering care to patients and acting on own initiative where appropriate.

The candidate will form a part of the nursing team responsible for ensuring the practice provides an optimum service of care to the practice population. They will undertake phlebotomy and some administration duties.

We are a fully staffed, supportive and dynamic practice with a clinical team compromising of 2 partners, 6 salaried GPs, 3 ANPs,1 pharmacist, Practice Nurses, HCAs and a complement of admin / managerial staff along with our reception team.

We work collaboratively with our PCN group and other practices. Our PCN staff include a pharmacist and physiotherapists and a social prescriber.

title: Consultant in General internal Medicine, Diabetes and Endocrinology
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for two enthusiastic colleagues to join our dynamic service at Newham University Hospital, within Barts Health NHS Trust.

Newham University Hospital (NUH) is a district general hospital with a major undergraduate teaching role, serving one of the youngest and most ethnically diverse populations in the UK. The hospital sits within a multicultural borough with a population of 355 000, with an average age of 32 years and a high prevalence of diabetes (8.5%). The service benefits from a purpose built diabetes centre located in East Ham with diabetes outpatient facilities co located with the community Type 2 Diabetes Specialist Nurse service provided by the East London Foundation Trust and onsite podiatry and X ray.

This is an exciting opportunity to join the award winning Diabetes and Endocrinology team at a time of significant investment and service expansion. The post includes general medicine, endocrinology and diabetes management in the inpatient and outpatient setting. The exact job plan may be tailored to the interests and experience of the successful candidate.

We are a friendly and supportive team comprising with these posts 6 consultants in diabetes/endocrinology based at NUH, and three associate specialists. The resident team consists of two diabetes and endocrine specialist registrars, one maternal medicine specialist registrar, one neurology specialist registrar (rotating through GIM), one IMT3 trainee, three IMT1s, one GPVTS trainee and four FY1 doctors.

We value clinical leadership across all our specialties, and Barts Health is committed to delivering an excellent leadership development programme in partnership with the King's Fund.

Barts Health is one of the largest NHS trusts in the country, and one of Britain's leading healthcare providers.

Our vision is to be a high-performing group of NHS hospitals, renowned for excellence and innovation, and providing safe and compassionate care to our patients in east London and beyond. That means being a provider of excellent patient safety, known for delivering consistently high standards of harm-free care and always caring for patients in the right place at the right time. It also means being an outstanding place to work, in which our WeCare values and behaviours are visible to all and guide us in how we work together.

We strive to live by our WeCare values and are committed to promoting inclusion, where every staff member has a sense of belonging. We value our differences and fully advocate, cultivate and support an inclusive working environment.

title: Salaried ARRS GP
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Salaried GP

With Full registration with the GMC with a license to Practice, to join our team under the NHS England Additional Roles Reimbursement Scheme (ARRS). In this role, you will be working across two practices within the North & West PCN: Weobley & Staunton Surgeries and Mortimer Medical Practice.

The Successful Candidate must be Formally listed on the GMC GP register

This unique setup provides a fantastic opportunity to experience different practice dynamics, build additional clinical capacity across our network, and collaborate with an expanded team of first-contact practitioners, clinical pharmacists, and advanced clinicians.

Job Summary:

To work as an autonomous practitioner, responsible for the provision of medical services to the practice population, delivering an excellent standard of clinical care whilst complying with the GMS contract. Furthermore, the post-holder will adhere to the GMC standards for good medical practice, contributing to the effective management of the practice, leading by example, maintaining a positive, collaborative working relationship with the multidisciplinary team.

In accordance with the practice timetable, as agreed, the postholder will make him/herself available to undertake a variety of duties including surgery consultations, telephone consultations and queries, visiting patients at home, checking and signing repeat prescription and dealing with queries, paperwork and correspondence in a timely fashion

Making professional, autonomous decisions in relation to presenting problems, whether self-referred or referred from other health care workers within the organisation

Assessing the health care needs of patients with undifferentiated and undiagnosed problems.

Screening patients for disease risk factors and early sign of illness.

In consultation with patients and in line with current practice disease management protocols, developing care plans for health.

Providing counselling and health education.

Admitting or discharging patients to and from the caseload and referring to other care providers as appropriate.

Recording clear and contemporaneous consultation notes to agreed standards.

Collecting data for audit purposes.

Compiling and issuing computer-generated acute and repeat prescriptions.

Prescribing in accordance with the practice prescribing formulary whenever this is clinically appropriate

The Weobley & Staunton-on-Wye Surgeries are a friendly, rural NHS GP practice situated in the beautiful Herefordshire countryside, approximately 12 miles from Hereford. We operate across two sites, with our main surgery in Weobley and a branch surgery in Staunton-on-Wye.

We provide primary care services to a patient population of approximately 6,500, covering a wide geographical area and a number of surrounding villages and rural communities. Both sites have their own on-site dispensaries, providing an important service to our rural population.

We are a well-established practice with a diverse and dedicated team of approximately 43 staff, working across clinical, administrative and management roles. We pride ourselves on providing high-quality, patient-centred care while maintaining a personal approach to the communities we serve.

We offer a broad range of general practice services and are committed to developing and improving the care we provide. We value teamwork, collaboration and a supportive working environment, encouraging our staff to contribute ideas, develop their skills and play an active part in the continued development of the practice.

We work closely with our neighbouring practices within the North & West Primary Care Network, recognising the importance of partnership working and collaborative approaches to delivering healthcare across our rural communities.

We are proud of our practice, our team and the communities we serve.

title: Rehabilitation Consultant
descriptionHtml:
Nottingham University Hospital NHS Trust (NUH) is looking for a fulltime Rehabilitation Consultant Physician to join an existing team of 3 NHS and academic consultants providing rehabilitation services to the people of Nottinghamshire and beyond.

The postholder will be a Consultant Physician with responsibility for Complex Rehabilitation across Nottingham University Hospitals NHS Trust. The successful candidate should expect to work between our sites at all campuses.

Please refer to the job description and person specification attached to the advert for the full details of the vacancy.

With over 17,000 staff, we are one of the biggest employers in the city with a central role in supporting the health and wellbeing of our local population. We play a leading role in research, education and innovation.

Come and join our wonderful team at NUH. We are big believers in diversity and welcome new ideas to help develop our team in order to deliver world class healthcare to the vast patient populations we serve. With endless personal development opportunities available, at NUH we will endeavour to turn your job into a career!

We particularly welcome applications from people who identify as Black, Asian and Minority Ethnic, or Disabled, as we are striving to be better represented at NUH.

title: PCN GP
descriptionHtml:
St Helens North PCN is seeking a motivated and enthusiastic GP to join our Primary Care Network under the Additional Roles Reimbursement Scheme (ARRS), in line with the NHS Directed Enhanced Service (DES). This is an excellent opportunity for a GP to gain valuable experience working within an innovative, supportive, and multidisciplinary PCN environment working across the 6 practices in St Helens PCN North.

The successful applicant must be eligible for the role as per guidelines as set out in the DES.

This role is fixed term till 31st March 2028 and we would consider a less than full time application.

We are unable to accept applications from applicants who require Visa Sponsorship.

No recruitment agencies please.

The successful applicant will join our friendly Urgent Care Hub team, working alongside one other GP and the Hub Manager. The purpose of the Urgent Care Hub (UCH) is to support the increasing demand in general practice for same day / urgent care and provide patients with increased and improved access to urgent care.

You will work in partnership with the six practices that make up the PCN, as well as with other ARRS staff and partner organisations, supporting the care of patients requiring urgent same-day appointments. You will play a key role in helping to redesign and refine how we deliver care to these patients, contributing to improved outcomes and service efficiency.

The Urgent Care Hub (UCH) which runs Monday to Friday, 10am to 6pm aims to help meet the growing demand for same-day and urgent care within general practice, offering patients of the PCN enhanced and timely access to urgent medical services.

In addition to carrying out urgent hub appointments which have seasonal demand, there is an opportunity to develop or bring specific areas of expertise in / to this role. As a PCN we would have a preference for this to be supporting in ADHD service development, which is new to the PCN, or would consider alternative specialities such as cardiovascular disease, dermatology, etc.

Please refer to the job description and person specification attached for full details.

As part of the PCN, you will collaborate closely with a diverse range of healthcare professionals, delivering high-quality, patient-centred care while developing your clinical skills and experience. The post holder will be an integral part of St Helens North Primary Care Network, a collaborative team comprising six practices: Garswood Surgery, Windermere Medical Centre, Bethany Medical Centre, Kenneth MacRae Medical Centre, Rainford Health Centre, and Billinge Medical Centre. Together, we serve a combined patient population of approximately 30,000.

Our PCN prides itself on being a friendly, close-knit team driven by a strong work ethic focused on motivation, productivity, respect, and innovation. This is a new and exciting opportunity to join an expanding and diverse Primary Care Network, dedicated to improving patient care while supporting your professional development and enhancing your clinical skills.

Our mission is to provide pro-active care to patients to improve their health and wellbeing and to make a positive impact to their lives, with respect and compassion. Working in partnership with local people, health and social care, voluntary sectors, community groups and colleagues to bring communities together and helping to reduce health inequalities.

title: Clinical Director (Clinical Networks) - Diabetes
descriptionHtml:
Are you a senior clinician with the strategic vision, credibility and experience to lead improvement across London?

NHS England are recruiting a Clinical Director working in London's health and care system to provide visible strategic leadership across the diabetes pathway.

Working with clinical leaders, Integrated Care Boards, providers, patient representative groups, Health Innovation Networks and other strategic partners, you will lead and design a London-wide programme focused on improving clinical outcomes, reducing unwarranted variation and supporting the spread and adoption of evidence-based practice and innovation. You will provide expert clinical advice, strategic leadership and act as an ambassador for clinical improvement across London.You will be a clinically qualified senior leader with GMC or other appropriate professional registration and a licence to practise, with significant NHS leadership experience and recognised expertise in diabetes care. You will bring the influence, judgement and collaborative leadership needed to deliver change across London's complex health and care system. This is why strategic and operational leadership experience in London is important.

This is an exciting opportunity to lead the improvement of outcomes and experience of care for the London population and to coordinate action to reduce health inequalities.

The time commitment for this role is 0.1 WTE.

Working with other Clinical Network Directors and strategic partners, the post-holder will contribute to the regional delivery of the 10-Year Health Plan and implementation of the Cardiovascular Modern Service Framework.

NHS England has a wide range of statutory functions, responsibilities and regulatory powers. These are focused on supporting the wider NHS to deliver high quality care, as well as doing those things that are best done once for the whole NHS.

Our staff bring expertise across clinical, operational, commissioning, technology, data science, cyber security, software engineering, education, and commercial specialisms -- enabling us to design and deliver high-quality NHS services.

In March 2025, the Government announced that NHS England and the Department of Health and Social Care will increasingly merge functions, ultimately leading to NHS England being fully integrated into the department.

If you currently work within the NHS and if successful at interview, we will initiate an Inter Authority Transfer (IAT) via the Electronic Staff Record (ESR).This retrieves key data from your current or previous NHS employer to support onboarding, including competency status, Continuous Service Dates (CSD), and annual leave entitlement. You may opt out at any stage of the process.

Colleagues with a contractual office base are expected to spend, on average, at least 40% of their time working in our offices.

We cannot offer visa sponsorship for external candidates.

title: Salaried GP
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a caring and motivated GP to join our supportive, forward-thinking practice. Whether you are newly qualified or an experienced doctor seeking a new challenge, this is a great opportunity to work in a friendly, well-established team where your contribution will be valued.

At Len Valley Practice we put patient care at the heart of everything we do. Youll be joining a team that works collaboratively across all disciplines, with a focus on quality, continuity of care, and innovation. We encourage professional development and will support you in shaping your role and career with us.

We are proud to be a welcoming and inclusive employer and can offer Tier 2 sponsorship for international candidates who require visa support.

If you are enthusiastic, compassionate, and committed to delivering excellent primary care, wed love to hear from you.

As a Salaried GP at Len Valley Practice, you will provide high-quality medical care to our patient population, in line with the requirements of the GMS contract. This will include the diagnosis, treatment and management of acute and long-term conditions, safe and evidence-based prescribing, and maintaining accurate and timely clinical records. You will manage a range of patient contacts such as face-to-face and telephone consultations, online queries, duty cover and occasional home visits, supported by our wider clinical and administrative team.

You will take responsibility for a fair share of the practice workload, including referrals, repeat prescribing, lab results, and workflow documents, ensuring these are completed in a timely manner. You will work within national and local guidelines, contribute to QOF and quality improvement activity, and support clinical governance across the practice.

The role also involves engaging in regular clinical meetings, audit and CPD, completing appraisal and revalidation requirements, and contributing to the development of services. You will be encouraged to support medical student training, share learning with colleagues, and participate in collaborative team working to promote a culture of continuous improvement.

In short, you will carry out the full range of duties expected of a GP in primary care while being part of a supportive, forward-thinking practice team.

Len Valley Practice is a friendly forward thinking GP surgery based in the historic village of Lenham Kent caring for just over ten thousand patients across Lenham and Harrietsham The practice is led by five GP partners supported by salaried GPs, GP registrars a strong nursing team, healthcare assistants, pharmacists, physiotherapy and paramedic practitioners as well as skilled administrative and dispensary staff.

We provide a wide range of primary care services including long term condition management, immunisations, maternity and family planning, minor surgery, health screening and treatment of illness or injury Rated Good by the Care Quality Commission the practice is committed to delivering safe effective and patient centred care.

We pride ourselves on being an approachable, supportive and community focused organisation with a strong emphasis on teamwork professional development and delivering high quality care for all

employer: Hampshire and Isle of Wight Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust
title: Salaried General Practitioner - Willow Group
descriptionHtml:
The Willow Group are looking for a Salaried GP to join our ever expanding team. You will be part of a dynamic team responsible for providing sustainable, population-based health and social care, while ensuring our patients are seen in a timely manner by the most appropriate clinician within the Extended Primary Care Team.

The Willow Group is unique; we are partnered with Hampshire and Isle of Wight Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust, which is one of the largest Community and Mental Health Trusts in the UK. This comes with the opportunity to expand your knowledge and develop your skills within multidisciplinary teams in different specialties.

The Willow Group work over 4 Sites providing:

*GP led, working with a highly skilled team of ANPs, Nurses, Pharmacists, CPNs, First Contact Practitioners in MSK, Physician's Associate, Paramedic, Social Prescribers and supported by a motivated and efficient admin team

*Training for FY2s, GP Registrars, Nurses and Physicians Associates

*Primary Care Research

*Same Day Access Service

*Home Visiting Service

*A Strong MDT approach to routine care

*15 minute appointments offering flexibility of telephone, video, on-line or face-to --face consultations

*Clinical administration sessions

*Forward thinking and innovative PCN

In general the post-holder will be expected to undertake all the normal duties and responsibilities associated with a GP working within primary care including:

Making professionally autonomous decisions in relation to presenting problems

Consults with patients in the surgery, at home visits and via telephone or on-line mechanisms

Undertakes triage calls, triage visits, checking and signing of repeat prescriptions

Screens patients for disease risk factors and early signs of illness.

In consultation with patients and in line with current Practice disease management protocols, develops care plans for health.

Provides counselling and health education as necessary.

Admits or discharges patients to and from caseload and refers them to other care providers internally and externally as appropriate

Complies with all relevant clinical governance and Practice polices and protocols.

Assists in the establishment of appropriate systems to manage common chronic medical conditions.

Records clear and contemporaneous consultation notes to agreed standards.

Provides active input to the wider Primary healthcare team in the process of health needs research/base line data collection/clinical audit.

Compiles and issues computer-generated acute and repeat prescriptions, prescribing in accordance with the Practice/Fareham & Gosport CCG prescribing formulary

Meets professional learning and CPD requirements.

Hampshire and Isle of Wight Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust provides joined-up mental and physical healthcare for around two million people across our communities. With over 13,000 staff working in the community and local hospitals, we deliver care at every stage of life, helping people live their best and healthiest lives.

Our mental health services include community-based support and early intervention in psychosis (EIP) for both adults and young people, alongside a network of specialist inpatient wards covering forensic, learning disability, eating disorder and older person's care.

We deliver extensive physical health services too, from urgent community response teams helping frail and older patients remain safely at home, to hospitals at home teams providing acute-level care in familiar surroundings. Our neurological services offer rehabilitation and treatment for conditions including Multiple Sclerosis, Parkinson's Disease, Motor Neurone Disease, Head Injury, Cerebral Palsy and Stroke. Across Hampshire, our community hospitals provide inpatient rehabilitation as a step down from acute care, and our dedicated teams also staff Treetops Sexual Assault Referral Centre in Portsmouth, offering expert, compassionate support.

Everything we do is underpinned by our CARE values of compassion, accountability, respect and excellence

title: Consultant Psychiatrist (Female PICU)
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an experienced full-time Consultant Psychiatrist who will work at Cygnet Hospital Beckton and provide senior medical cover on Svanna ward, our 12 bed PICU service for women.

The post holder will be the Responsible Clinician and will oversee and maintain the care of all ward inpatients as required and will also have responsibility for auditing the medical services rendered at the ward and ensuring their good quality in accordance to GMC standards of good medical practice and other relevant professional guidelines.

In this role, your expertise will be the driving force for life-changing treatment fully supported by a Specialty Doctor and first-class multidisciplinary team including qualified nurses, psychologist and occupational therapist.

You'll also have the opportunity to progress to Medical Director Level through our management schemes.

Cygnet Hospital Beckton has four different specialist wards including PICU, acute admissions and personality disorder services. We accept emergency and planned, pre-assessed admissions. Our aim is to support individual service user recovery and integration back into the community, as quickly as possible. We have a multi-disciplinary team of specialists and offer a very broad range of therapies.

The post holder will be the Responsible Clinician and have overall medical responsibility of patient treatment plans, whilst liaising closely with the Multi-Disciplinary Team (Psychologists, Occupational Therapists, Registered Mental Health Nurses, Social Workers etc.)

The post holder will be expected to act as a positive role model, maintaining and demonstrating a positive attitude towards patients, their families, visitors and other staff.

Cygnet have been providing a national network of high-quality specialist mental health services for more than 30 years. We have built a reputation for delivering pioneering services and outstanding outcomes. Our expert care enables thousands of individuals to consistently make a positive difference to their lives.

We maintain a good relationship with our quality regulators and undergo regular inspections, with 85% of our services rated Good or Outstanding. We also operate an internal system of quality care, treatment and positive outcomes.

title: Windsor Foot & Ankle Fellowship (BOFAS)
descriptionHtml:
Applications are sought for the Windsor Foot and Ankle Fellowship, a nationally recognised post-CCT 6-month training post based at Heatherwood and Wexham Park Hospitals.

The fellowship has been run by Mr Callum Clark and Mr Raman Dega since 2007 with Mr Jasdeep Giddie since 2020, and has an excellent reputation for preparing senior trainees for life as a Consultant foot and ankle surgeon.

title: Salaried GP
descriptionHtml:
We are looking to recruit a Salaried GP (6 sessions) to join our team of 19 GPs to care for our 32,000 patients in the centre of Hove. We would be particularly interested in GPs who have a special interest in Frailty

We are proud to be a genuinely GP-led practice. Clinical decision-making, service development and the future direction of the practice remain firmly in the hands of doctors committed to delivering outstanding primary care. Our GP leadership is complemented by an exceptional Managing Partner and experienced management team who provide the operational expertise needed to run a modern, high-performing practice

Our partnership is stable, ambitious and committed for the long term. Four of our current Partners first joined Charter as GP trainees before becoming Salaried GPs and subsequently Partners, reflecting our commitment to developing and retaining doctors.

We strongly believe in GP-led general practice. Our multidisciplinary team is designed to support and enhance GP care, enabling GPs to focus on providing expert medical care while working alongside our brilliant clinical colleagues.

We are supported by an experienced and highly valued reception, administrative and management team, and continually review our systems and workflows to reduce unnecessary administrative burden and help clinicians work efficiently and safely.

Teaching, training and professional development are central to our culture.

We are working towards the BMA model contract. GPs undertake 26 patient contacts per day, with protected time for occasional home visits, and we operate a list system because we believe strongly in continuity of care and long-term therapeutic relationships.

High-Quality Care

We are proud of our results and patient feedback:

CQC rated Good.

High QOF achievement.

NHS patient satisfaction score of 93.2%.

Google rating of 4.7 stars from more than 1,700 reviews.

What You'll Find at Charter

A supportive and collaborative GP team.

A genuinely GP-led organisation where your views matter.

Opportunities to teach, supervise and develop leadership roles.

Strong clinical and administrative support.

A culture that values kindness, professionalism and teamwork.

A beautiful coastal location in the heart of Hove.

If you are looking for a practice where you can develop meaningful long-term relationships with patients, work alongside supportive colleagues, and build a rewarding career within a genuinely GP-led organisation, we would love to hear from you.

title: Locum Consultant in Rheumatology
descriptionHtml:
Barts Health NHS Trust

Consultant Rheumatologist post

Fixed term: 12 months

Part time - 8PAs

Bart's Health NHS Trust are looking to recruit a replacement Rheumatology Consultant on a fixed term basis for 12 months. This is an exciting opportunity to join our Rheumatology team at Whipps Cross Hospital, Bart's Health NHS Trust. The successful applicant will be responsible for providing general in-patient and outpatient adult rheumatology care, with out-of- hours and on-call commitments

Rheumatology sits within the Division of Medicine directorate. Barts Health Rheumatology Service has been established for over 50 years and during that time has become recognised as a leading national and international rheumatology centre of excellence. Many members of the teams are leading UK experts in their fields, and all provide high-quality specialist care.

Barts Health will employ the successful candidate as a 8 PA consultant for a period of 12 months. This post will be offered as a full time 8 PA Rheumatology job.

The post will span hospitals where there are 20 consultant rheumatologists, 4 SpRs, 8 specialist nurses, a specialist physiotherapist, and administrative staff. The post holder will be expected to provide supervision to the SpRs in outpatients and on the wards. There will be secretarial support provided. Office space with IT and phone links will be provided.

Duties other than those clinical duties specified will be arranged in accordance with the work program to be agreed with the appointee, the Lead Clinician, the Medical Director and the Chief Executive, and will allow time for administration, teaching and medical audit.

The post holder will work with other consultants in the department delivering a comprehensive specialist service for rheumatology patients. The appointee will be expected to contribute in the following ways:

The post holder will fully participate in the care of Rheumatology patients, working closely with other professionals to provide comprehensive care both in and out of the hospital. This includes liaison with general practice with regard to the ongoing management of patients with chronic conditions.

Barts Health is one of the largest NHS trusts in the country, and one of Britain's leading healthcare providers.

Our vision is to be a high-performing group of NHS hospitals, renowned for excellence and innovation, and providing safe and compassionate care to our patients in east London and beyond. That means being a provider of excellent patient safety, known for delivering consistently high standards of harm-free care and always caring for patients in the right place at the right time. It also means being an outstanding place to work, in which our WeCare values and behaviours are visible to all and guide us in how we work together.

We strive to live by our WeCare values and are committed to promoting inclusion, where every staff member has a sense of belonging. We value our differences and fully advocate, cultivate and support an inclusive working environment.

title: Salaried GP - Haydock Medical Centre
descriptionHtml:

Join us as a General Practitioner within St Helens Division, Modality Partnership, and help shape the future of Primary Care.

If you are passionate about delivering high-quality, patient-centred care, value collaboration, and are seeking flexibility within a forward-thinking organisation, we would love to hear from you.

We are seeking a compassionate and motivated GP to join Haydock Medical Centre with part-time opportunities available (6-8 sessions per week). This role offers more than traditional General Practice, combining innovation, strong clinical governance, and modern ways of working. Recent developments include robotic processing of blood results and prescriptions, alongside early adoption of digital and AI solutions that streamline day-to-day practice.

You will work within a large, supportive multidisciplinary team, delivering safe and effective care while maintaining a healthy worklife balance. This is an opportunity to influence service delivery, develop professionally, and make a meaningful difference every day.

  • NHS pension scheme
  • Minimum 6 weeks annual leave + 8 bank holidays (pro rata)

This is a patient-centred General Practitioner role, delivered from your nominated practice site and supported by a multidisciplinary team.

title: Consultant Dermatologist
descriptionHtml:
Akessa Healthcare requires a Consultant Dermatologist to provide cover across our hospital sites. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a highly reputable organisation and to provide the highest standards of care.

An excellent, competitive remuneration package is on offer. The appointee may choose to work as a self-employed consultant under practising privileges or to be employed by the hospital on a sessional basis. There is currently a long waiting list of private patients seeking dermatology consultation and treatment, so full lists are available from the outset. There are also opportunities to pursue niche interests in medical, surgical or laser dermatology.

With a supportive network and a healthy worklife balance, you can expect autonomy and an environment where collaboration is celebrated. Everything is designed to enable our consultant colleagues to care for our patients with efficiency, generosity and compassion.

A harmonious work pattern is part of our wider commitment to improving the quality and experience of working with our team. We therefore welcome open conversations about a working pattern that suits your worklife balance. If it works for you and works for the role, we will do our best to make it happen.

The successful candidate will be provided with appropriate secretarial support for clinical work and diary management.

The role is provision of dermatology care to self paying and insured private patients.

The main clinical activities include:

  • Skin cancer diagnosis and management: a high-prevalence region with excellent referral pathways, and standard surgical excisions in a dedicated procedure suite
  • General and complex medical dermatology: acne, eczema, psoriasis, rosacea, paediatric dermatology, inflammatory disease and urticaria
  • Optional specialist care: Mohs surgery, CO and picosecond lasers, cosmetic dermatology and energy-based devices

The post will be based at the Royal Buckinghamshire Hospital in Aylesbury and The New Foscote Hospital in Banbury. The role involves outpatient clinics and minor skin surgery at both sites.

Applications for a minimum of one weekly session (each session lasting three hours) will be considered.

The Akessa Healthcare Group owns and operates several boutique independent hospitals, including The New Foscote Hospital, the Royal Buckinghamshire Hospital and 107 Harley Street.

The New Foscote Hospital was established in Banbury over 40 years ago and has provided services and treatments to thousands of people from across the region. More than 70 consultants, all leaders in their specialist fields, choose to hold their private practices here, working alongside our friendly, highly qualified and experienced nursing and support teams. In March 2024, The New Foscote Hospital was ranked among the top 10 NHS and private hospitals in the UK for patient satisfaction scores, as published by PHIN.

The Royal Buckinghamshire Hospital was established in Aylesbury in 1832 and has a long history of caring for patients from across the county. Ownership of the hospital transferred to our new management team in January 2023. The site boasts a state-of-the-art rehabilitation facility, including a hydrotherapy pool, virtual reality, zero-gravity and exoskeleton rehabilitation.

Our hospital group is managed and run by clinicians. Our organisation has strong IT, operational, clinical governance and accountancy support. The latest CQC report rated our hospitals as Good across all domains. All colleagues are encouraged to feel empowered and to have an active voice in the management of their services.

title: Consultant In Intensive Care Medicine
descriptionHtml:
Following a £5 million investment, the Intensive Care Unit has undergone a significant refurbishment and expansion and now provides 14 modern bed spaces, including two side rooms. The unit is currently funded to a dependency of 08, comprising Level 2 and Level 3 critical care, with beds used flexibly according to patient need.

The refurbished unit provides an excellent environment in which to deliver and develop critical care services. Medical equipment includes integrated patient monitoring and ventilator technology alongside electronic patient records and prescribing systems, with bedside ultrasound and modern renal replacement therapies available to support the management of acutely unwell patients. There is significant opportunity to continue developing the service, including enhanced care pathways and new ways of delivering care.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a supportive and forward-thinking department, providing high-quality critical care to a broad range of patients and working closely with colleagues across the wider multidisciplinary team.

We welcome applications from candidates with or without a background in Anaesthesia. Our priority is to appoint an excellent intensivist who will complement our existing team, and the role can be shaped to reflect the successful candidate's skills, experience and areas of specialist interest.

The successful candidate will contribute to the delivery and development of the Intensive Care service, including clinical care, outreach, governance, teaching, quality improvement and service development. There will also be opportunities to take on leadership responsibilities and develop areas of special interest.

For candidates who are also suitably qualified in Anaesthesia and wish to maintain anaesthetic practice, there is scope for this to be incorporated into the role. However, Anaesthesia is not an essential requirement for appointment.

The department places a strong emphasis on multidisciplinary working, education and training, clinical governance and continuous improvement. Consultants are actively encouraged to contribute to teaching, audit and the ongoing development of the service.

We are looking for someone who is collaborative, enthusiastic and keen to play an active role in developing Critical Care services for our patients. Whether your background is solely in Intensive Care Medicine or dual practice with Anaesthesia, we would be very pleased to hear from you.

title: Trust Doctor in Thoracic Medicine (ST6-8)
